statement: Let $t>1$ be a rational number. Is\[\sum_{n=1}^\infty\frac{1}{t^n-1}=\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{\tau(n)}{t^n}\]irrational, where $\tau(n)$ counts the divisors of $n$?
remarks: A conjecture of Chowla. Erd\H{o}s \cite{Er48} proved that this is true if $t\geq 2$ is an integer.
references: [Er48] Erd\H{o}s, P., On arithmetical properties of Lambert series. J. Indian Math. Soc. (N.S.) (1948), 63-66.
